title: anginon rugosum
intro: Anginon rugosum, commonly known as Rock Centaury, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal problems. The health benefits of Anginon rugosum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, soothing digestive issues, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Anginon rugosum include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
